## Description {#details}

<p>Human (standard output) implementation of <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter">reporter</a></span>.</p>


<p><span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter-human">reporter_human</a></span> provides a concrete implementation of the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter">reporter</a></span> abstract interface, formatting and presenting test results in a human-readable form. It accumulates output in an internal string buffer and writes it to the standard output stream, supporting colour-coded diagnostics (when the output is a terminal) and multiple verbosity levels.</p>


<p>The reporter is created by the runner, as selected by the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">--<a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter">reporter</a></span> command-line option. A different output format requires a new class derived from <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter">reporter</a></span>, and an extension of the runner to create it.</p>


<p>All members and methods are defined within the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus">micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus</a></span> namespace, ensuring clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.</p>


<p>Definition at line 108 of file <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter-human-h">reporter-human.h</a>.</p>

<p>This operator overload enables the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter">reporter</a></span> to output pointer values in a consistent and readable format.</p>


<p>Null pointers are always rendered as the string <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"0x0"</span>, regardless of the platform, avoiding platform-specific representations such as <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"(nil)"</span> on Linux/glibc.</p>


<p>Non-null pointers are formatted as a hexadecimal address using <span class="doxyComputerOutput">snprintf</span> with the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">p</span> format specifier. The resulting string is appended to the internal output buffer, allowing pointer values to be included in test reports and diagnostics.</p>


<p>This approach provides clear and unambiguous representation of pointer addresses, which is particularly useful for debugging and verifying pointer-related test cases.</p>

<p>If verbosity is not silent, a blank line is printed to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span> before the build-information block emitted by <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter/#a7ee71ebee4a54fb4b05c1f476cc78263">write_info_()</a></span>. The <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter/#a3961bc77e50ecbade82b29dd5983ddec">add_empty_line_</a></span> flag is set so that subsequent suite output is visually separated.</p>

<p>This method marks the beginning of a test case. The output buffer must be empty at this point; if it is not, its content is written to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stderr</span> and execution is aborted.</p>


<p>A <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"• &lt;name&gt;"</span> line, indented according to the nesting depth, is written to the output file (if open) and, with verbose verbosity, to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span>, preceded by an empty line when <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter/#a3961bc77e50ecbade82b29dd5983ddec">add_empty_line_</a></span> is set.</p>

<p>Unless verbosity is silent, prints a summary line to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span> (and to the output file if open) showing the total number of successful checks, failed checks, executed test cases, and test suites, together with the elapsed time when timing data is available. The line is prefixed with a green <span class="doxyComputerOutput">✓</span> tick on success or a red <span class="doxyComputerOutput">✗</span> cross on failure, using ANSI colour codes when colour output is enabled.</p>

<p>Mark the end of a subtest.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">

<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>With normal or verbose verbosity, this method summarises the outcome of the test case, with appropriate formatting and colour coding; for silent or quiet verbosity levels, no output is produced.</p>


<p>For passing test cases, a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"✓ &lt;name&gt; - passed"</span> line is shown with the number of checks; the buffered check results are written to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span> only with verbose verbosity. For failing test cases, the buffered check results are always shown (preceded, with normal verbosity, by the test case name), followed by a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"✗ &lt;name&gt; - FAILED"</span> line with the number of successful and failed checks. The buffered results are always written to the output file.</p>


<p>Finally, the streams are flushed and the buffer is cleared.</p>

### end\_suite() {#ac0a6d2bda91a9afa71346eef59c7f35e}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">

<td class="doxyMemberName">void micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::reporter_human::end_suite (<a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/suite">suite</a> &amp; suite)</td>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Mark the end of a test suite.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">suite</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>Reference to the test suite.</p></td>
</tr>
</table>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>With normal or verbose verbosity, this method summarises the results of the test suite, with appropriate formatting and colour coding; for silent or quiet verbosity levels, no output is produced. An empty line is first added if the suite executed any test cases.</p>


<p>For suites without failed checks, a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"✓ &lt;name&gt; - passed"</span> line is displayed, including the number of checks and test cases; the buffered check results are written to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span> only with verbose verbosity. Otherwise, a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">"✗ &lt;name&gt; - FAILED"</span> line is shown, detailing the number of successful and failed checks and the number of test cases, preceded by the buffered check results. The buffered results are always written to the output file. The elapsed time is appended when available.</p>


<p>Finally, the streams are flushed and the buffer is cleared.</p>

<p>This method appends a newline character to the internal output buffer of the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter">reporter</a></span> and calls <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter/#ae7f404f29f265c5db6038f1e03f854b2">flush()</a></span>. <p>Provides access to the expression formatter for this reporter.</p>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">

<p>Returns a reference to the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">expression_formatter</span> instance used by the reporter for formatting expressions in test reports. <div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Output the current buffered content to the console.</p>


<p>The console is the standard output stream; the buffer is written verbatim, without appending a line ending, and is not cleared.</p>



:::info
<p>Public because <span class="doxyComputerOutput">deferred_reporter_base</span> calls this from its destructor when aborting, after the subtest instance is no longer accessible via the normal reporting path.</p>
:::

<dd><p>None.</p></dd>
</dl>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>This method writes the contents of the internal output buffer to the console without appending a newline character. The buffer is not cleared; the caller is responsible for clearing it when appropriate.</p>

<p>This method outputs the prefix for a failing check result, indented one level deeper than the subtest. The prefix includes a cross symbol (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">✗</span>), an optional message, and the label "FAILED", both symbol and label in the fail colour. The source location (file name and line number) follows, after an opening parenthesis; when the failure has an expression, a comma separator is added, so that the expression follows inside the parentheses.</p>

### write\_buffer\_to\_file\_() {#ae656aff0d07d7cc634f1a0b2046137e9}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">

<span class="doxyMemberLabels">
<span class="doxyMemberLabel protected">protected</span>
</span>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Output the current buffered content to the output file.</p>


<p>The buffer is written without appending a line ending, and is not cleared. ANSI colour sequences are removed, so the file receives plain text even when the console output is coloured. If no output file is open, the call has no effect.</p>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd><p>None.</p></dd>
</dl>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>Writes the contents of <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter/#a6eed4eaebea91b3377b89a118eb1c323">buffer_</a></span> to <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter/#a1d95688325caf323a4d77272dcf50b86">output_file_</a></span> without appending a newline. If <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter/#a1d95688325caf323a4d77272dcf50b86">output_file_</a></span> is null, the call is a no-op.</p>


<p>The buffer may contain ANSI colour sequences, added when the console is a terminal, which must not reach the file. They are removed while writing: each <span class="doxyComputerOutput">ESC [</span>, followed by any digits and semicolons, and terminated by <span class="doxyComputerOutput">m</span>, is skipped, and the text between the sequences is written unchanged. Any other use of <span class="doxyComputerOutput">ESC</span> is written as is.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Write formatted text to the console.</p>


<p>All reporter console output is routed through this function, so that it reaches the standard output stream via a single path, shared with the output of the user <span class="doxyComputerOutput">printf()</span> calls. Using one stream-based path keeps the reporter and user output in the same buffer, preserving their relative order.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">format</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>A <span class="doxyComputerOutput">printf()</span>-style format string.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">...</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The arguments referred to by the format string.</p></td>
</tr>
</table>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>The arguments are forwarded to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">vfprintf()</span> on <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span>. The stream is explicit, so the compiler does not rewrite the call into <span class="doxyComputerOutput">puts()</span> or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">putchar()</span>, and all console output shares the same <span class="doxyComputerOutput">FILE</span>-based path.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Writes the informational (non-result) lines to the console and to the output file.</p>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Parameters</dt>
<dd><p>None.</p></dd>
</dl>


<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Returns</dt>
<dd><p>Nothing.</p></dd>
</dl>


<p>Constructs and emits two informational lines, each prefixed by <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/reporter/#a9cafc8992d508b5ffa0b6a64226202bd">get_comment_prefix()</a></span>: the first lists the program name (without the path) and any command-line arguments; the second identifies the compiler (Clang, GCC, or MSVC) together with the version string, floating-point availability on bare-metal targets, exception support, and any active debug or trace macros. Both lines are written to the output file when one is open, and to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">stdout</span> when the verbosity is <span class="doxyComputerOutput">normal</span> or <span class="doxyComputerOutput">verbose</span>, except when both <span class="doxyComputerOutput">MICRO_OS_PLUS_STARTUP_ENABLED</span> and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">MICRO_OS_PLUS_DIAG_TRACE_ENABLED</span> are defined, since the startup code already displays this information.</p>
